rationale: I read the complete held EO 12240 (45 FR 64545, Sept. 30, 1980, signed Sept. 26, 1980, Nuclear Safety Oversight Committee): it amends EO 12202 by adding a funding sentence to sec. 1-303 (support under sec. 213 of the Independent Offices Appropriations Act, 1945, from Oct. 1, 1980), replacing sec. 1-402 with 'The Committee shall terminate on September 30, 1981.' and raising membership from five to six (sec. 1-103). It is a pure amendment of EO 12202 (which I also read; its own sec. 1-402 term was Sept. 30, 1980). I read the held full text of EO 12379 (47 FR 36099, Aug. 19, 1982, signed Aug. 17, 1982, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions): its stated purpose is 'to terminate the establishing authorities for committees that are inactive or no longer necessary', and sec. 22 reads 'Executive Order No. 12202, as amended, establishing the Nuclear Safety Oversight Committee, is revoked.' EO 12202 as amended includes the EO 12240 changes, so the whole of EO 12240's effect ended with its parent; there is no exception or savings clause. The machine ACT labels the reach 'whole_via_parent' with names_target false, which is accurate because sec. 22 names EO 12202 as amended rather than EO 12240. Own-term check: EO 12240's own substituted term ended the Committee on Sept. 30, 1981, earlier than the revocation, and no held order extends it, so any end is at the latest Aug. 17, 1982 and the NO holds either way (the first-end date is left to lifecycle review). D6 self-check: a text search of the held full-run texts finds EO 12202 and EO 12240 named only in 12202, 12240, 12379 and 12399 (other hits are index or page noise); EO 12399 sec. 4(c) (Dec. 31, 1982, held) revokes EO 12202 again as a committee that has terminated, which confirms rather than disturbs the end; no order extends, revives or re-delegates the Committee's functions after EO 12379. The 1989 snapshot row is empty and the editorial bound is a lead only. Provisional NO hypothesis; the effective end is not otherwise adjudicated.
